title: Skill Node
description: An atomic skill in the canonical skill graph (core design doc §1.2). A skill is atomic when a student can be meaningfully diagnosed as having it or not. Prerequisite edges point to conceptual prerequisites only (§1.2a); depth within a node is expressed on the difficulty scalar, not as edges.

skill_id.description: Canonical dotted identifier, e.g. FRAC.ADD.UNLIKE. Built once; questions and mappings reference skills by this id.

name.description: Short human-readable name, e.g. "Add fractions with unlike denominators".

description.description: Precise definition of what the skill covers (§1.2).

strand.description: Top-level organization, e.g. NUMBER.FRACTIONS (§1.2). Placement and diagnosis walk per strand.

canonical_stage.description: Abstract ordering index, NOT a grade (§1.2). Grade placement lives in the country mapping layer (§1.4).

prerequisites.description: Conceptual prerequisite skill_ids (§1.2a). A student is served this skill only once each prerequisite is certified at the depth the target item requires (§1.3, §2.3).

misconceptions.description: Known failure modes for this skill — references into the misconception registry (§2.4).
